description: NAS Parallel Benchmarks Embarrassingly Parallel (EP): faithful port of the NPB-GPU EP kernel. Generates 2^(M+1) pseudorandom numbers with the NAS 46-bit linear congruential generator (randlc), forms Gaussian deviate pairs by the Marsaglia polar acceptance-rejection method, tallies them into 10 concentric square annuli, and accumulates the Sx/Sy sums. Purely compute-bound. The class exponent M sets the problem size (M=24 Class S, 28 Class A, 30 Class B, 32 Class C).

scaling_param.name: m
scaling_param.description: Class exponent M: generates 2^(M+1) random numbers over 2^(M-16) threads (M=24 S, 25 W, 28 A, 30 B, 32 C)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
